title: Shortest Path in Unweighted Graph
statement:
Given an undirected unweighted graph with `n` nodes (0-indexed) and `e` edges, find the shortest path (minimum number of edges) from node `src` to node `dest`.
If no path exists, print `-1`.
inputFormat:
Line 1: two integers n and e.
Next e lines: two integers u and v.
Last line: two integers src and dest.

starterCode.python:
from collections import deque
n, e = map(int, input().split())
adj = [[] for _ in range(n)]
for _ in range(e):
    u, v = map(int, input().split())
    adj[u].append(v)
    adj[v].append(u)
src, dest = map(int, input().split())
